design: Fixed natural core32, partner32. Actual-only, angle-only, equal normalized mixture. Each family loss divided by its TRAINING mean cross-target squared norm, even in validation. Mixture batches128 each, single-family256; same400 updates/total examples, not identical kernel cost. Twelve fixed runs; validation objective chooses checkpoints, including0. First768 discovery train, next256 validation. Separate seeded same-head norm/angle payloads on test. Native coefficients fixed.

gates.angle_rescue: Mixture minus actual-only angle cross fidelity>=10pt with paired95 lower>0 BOTH scales.
gates.actual_retention: Mixture minus actual-only actual cross paired95 lower>−3pt BOTH scales.
gates.near_specialists: Mixture minus respective specialist cross paired95 lower>−5pt BOTH families/scales.

scope: Reused H273128 docs, new angle draws; not fresh document replication. Nonconvex fixed-budget optimization, no global optimum claim. Cross fidelity is not total/downstream performance.
